## File: `references/languages/javascript.md`

### Detection signals — JavaScript/TypeScript (Security: Operational)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). Logger masking defaults (`pino` `redact`, `winston` formats) and `NODE_ENV` behaviour of libraries
aren't localized: judge explicit configuration only, and add a `localized-standard-gap` note when a decision depends
on a default.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Express app with no final `(err, req, res, next)` handler; handler sending `err.stack`/`err.message` | app setup | Default or leaky error responses | NDO-03, ERR-01 |
| `process.on('uncaughtException'` / `'unhandledRejection'` without `process.exit` | entry point | Process resumed after crash | NDO-01, A10-01 |
| `catch (e) {}`, `.catch(() => {})` with no log or rethrow | any | Swallowed errors | ERR-03, A10-07 |
| Streams/emitters without `.on('error', …)`; async handlers without `next(err)` | handlers | Unhandled errors | NDO-02 |
| `logger.info(req.body)`, `console.log(password)`, `JSON.stringify(user)` into logs | any | Secrets/PII in logs | LOG elements under SEC-OP-03 |
| `` logger.info(`login ${req.body.user}`) `` with no structured fields | any | Log injection risk | LOG elements under SEC-OP-04 |
| `const API_KEY = "sk_…"`, `password: "…"` in `config/*.js`, `.env` with values in the repo | config | Hardcoded secrets | SMG-01, SMG-02 |
| `app.use(errorhandler())` (dev error page) not gated on `NODE_ENV !== 'production'`; `DEBUG=*` in production config | app setup, env files | Debug output in production | SEC-OP-07 elements |

## File: `references/standards/node-operational.md`

*Load rule: NDO-01…05. Load when language `javascript` is detected.*

### Node.js / Express operational security guidance — localized summary

- Applies when language `javascript` is detected and the code runs on Node.js (server code, not browser bundles);
  Express rows need `express` as a dependency. 
- Level: `MUST` where the source says must/must not/never/do not or gives an unqualified imperative; `SHOULD` for
  should/recommended/encouraged/"consider". **(Default)** marks an element that states library behaviour or a default;
  cite the OWASP element that is violated and name this element in the recommendation. Defaults stated here are the
  only Node.js/Express defaults a worker may rely on. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NDO-01 | MUST | A `process.on('uncaughtException')` handler, if present, cleans up, logs the error and exits; the process isn't resumed after an uncaught exception, and stack traces aren't shown to users. | `process.on('uncaughtException', e => console.log(e))` with no exit | SEC-OP-10 |
| NDO-02 | SHOULD | `error` events are always listened to on EventEmitters and streams, and async errors are propagated (an `Error` as the first callback argument; Express handlers pass errors to `next(err)`, since Express doesn't catch errors that never reach it). | streams or emitters without `.on('error')`; async route handlers without `try/catch`→`next(err)` or a wrapper on Express 4 | SEC-OP-02 |
| NDO-03 | MUST | The default Express 404 and error responses are replaced by custom handlers that return generic messages. | no final `(err, req, res, next)` handler; handler sending `err.stack` or `err.message` | SEC-OP-01 |
| NDO-04 | SHOULD | Application activity is logged through a logging library (`winston`, `bunyan`, `pino`) with separate destinations for errors and general logs, not ad-hoc `console.log`. | security-relevant events only in `console.log`; no logger configured | SEC-OP-08 |
| NDO-05 | SHOULD | Unused routes, including framework auto-generated REST endpoints (Sails blueprints, Feathers services), are disabled. | Sails `blueprints` actions/rest enabled for models that don't need them | SEC-OP-07 |
